rows.claim: Once the flag is set, running `python3 checks/verify.py` again should make both checks pass.
rows.evidence: The verify run in T0B7 showed gateway_timeout PASS and web_new_checkout FAIL (new_checkout=off). The only failing check is the flag, so once it is set to on, both checks should pass. The claim is hedged ("should") and is consistent with the check definitions in verify.py. It is a prediction, but the tool outputs back it.
